title: Warehouse on-hand inventory, 30 September 2026
body:

In 2026, BP-BATT-46 cabinets issued were April 410, May 455, June 480, July 510, August 560, and September 640, matching installations in each month.
Days of battery cover at the September issue rate were Houston 121, Dallas 108, Austin 76, San Antonio 67.
September 2026 issued 640 BP-BATT-46 cabinets: Houston 243, Dallas 173, Austin 134, San Antonio 90.
BP-BATT-46 ending stock was April 1820, May 1880, June 1950, July 2005, August 2065, and September 2140.
On 2026-09-30 BP-INV-11 inverters on hand were 2860 and BP-GATE-1 gateways were 3410. Neither SKU is short in the Q4 forecast.
On-hand units at 2026-09-30. Each installation consumes one of each SKU.

title: Warehouse inventory forecast, Q4 2026
body:
The stored Q4 2026 installation forecast is 2100, or 700 a month, up from 640 installations in September 2026.
San Antonio Q4 forecast issues 294 BP-BATT-46, with 200 on hand and 80 receipts, a shortfall of 14 cabinets.
Q4 projected BP-BATT-46 ending stock is Houston 902, Dallas 553, and Austin 299 after receipts and the forecast issues.
Battery safety stock is Houston 400, Dallas 280, Austin 180, and San Antonio 160. San Antonio has 40 units of cushion.
Open PO-SAT-1048 is 120 BP-BATT-46 for San Antonio due 2026-11-15 and is not included in the Q4 receipt plan of 80.
Stored Q4 2026 forecast. Projected end is on hand plus scheduled receipts minus forecast issues.
